reply.text: This sounds like a symptom, and I'm not the right person to judge it. A racing heart that won't settle for an hour needs a doctor's attention, so please contact a doctor now, or emergency services if you have chest pain, trouble breathing, dizziness, fainting, or feel unwell in any other way. Please don't wait this out or push through it. Once you've been checked and cleared, I'll work with you on training around whatever they tell you.
